EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

KING (he) addresses his trusted advisor, a bespectacled wizard named ZORVATH (he).

KING
(to Zorvath)
I have a vision, my friend. A vision of a new era for our empire. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of futurism.

ZORVATH
(skeptical)
Futurism, Your Majesty? But we are in the 14th century.

KING
(nodding)
Exactly. We must think outside the box, my friend. We must... we must... (he gestures wildly)...we must vaporwave our aesthetic.

Yes, Your Majesty. I can arrange that.

KING
(nodding)
Good. And I want our architecture to be... to be... (he looks around the room)...to be a fusion of medieval and... and... (he searches for the right words)...of cyberpunk.

The king's vision is now a reality. The kingdom is filled with towering, neon-lit spires and grand, sweeping arches. The streets are filled with strange, futuristic contraptions, and the people are all dressed in the latest "vaporwave" fashions.

KING

(surprised)

KING
(smiling)
I knew you'd see it my way. Now, let us... let us... (he gestures to a nearby knight)...let us celebrate our new era of futurism!

KING
(to the knight)
Take us to the... the... (he searches for the right words)...to the "Vaporwave Palace"!

KING
(to the courtiers)
And let us... let us... (he searches for the right words)...let us feast and dance the night away!

The king and his courtiers are dancing and feasting in a grand, futuristic hall. The walls are adorned with holographic projections, and the tables are filled with strange, glowing dishes.

KING

KING
(to the courtiers)
Let us... let us... (he searches for the right words)...let us make this a new era for our empire. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of vaporwave.
